Counter affidavit filed by learned Aga today is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned AGA for the State-respondents and perused the record.

This writ petition has been filed witha prayer to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari for quashing of First Information Report dated 18.2.2024 registered as Case Crime No.

Learned AGA, on the basis of his instructions, states that in this case, charge sheet is already prepared with regard to petitioner nos. 1, 2 and 4 and submitted before the supervisory authority for approval of the same on 20.3.2024 and name of petitioner no. 3 is dropped during investigation.

In view of the above, liberty is granted to the petitioners to move an appropriate application raising all their grievances before the supervisory authority, who shall look into the matter and pass an order in accordance with law.
With the aforesaid direction, writ petition is disposed off.

. 
(Narendra Kumar Johari, J.) (Vivek Chaudhary,J.) Order Date :- 10.7.2024
